title: Competitive Intel
overview_sources: Data: HubSpot 35 closed-lost deals (Jul 15–Sep 22) · competitor sites + ad libraries · SEMrush
notes: Freshness stamps for competitive-intel.html. `updated` is the last weekly signal + keyword refresh (the Monday CI weekly routine, CI_WEEKLY_ROUTINE.md). `full_run` is the last complete competitive-intel skill run (bi-monthly: website + ad-library analysis, threat levels, messaging themes, AI summaries, strategic opportunities). Both the page header and the dashboard tab banner read their dates from this file, and the page counts tracked competitors from its own DOM, so no date or count is hardcoded in the HTML. `stale_after_days` drives the freshness pill: once `updated` is older than that, the page shows its age in amber instead of a green 'current'. `overview_updated` is the last rewrite of the AI Overview block (narrative, chips, pressure panel, top signals, stat tiles); the overview pill turns amber after `overview_stale_after_days`. The weekly routine does not rewrite the overview.
